program.source: export function evaluate({ inputs, time }) { const launchSpeed = inputs.launchSpeed; const gravity = inputs.gravity; const apexTime = launchSpeed / gravity; const apexHeight = (launchSpeed * launchSpeed) / (2 * gravity); const t = Math.max(0, time); const tossedVelocity = launchSpeed - gravity * t; const tossedAcceleration = -gravity; const tossedHeight = launchSpeed * t - 0.5 * gravity * t * t; const isAtTop = t >= apexTime; const dropTime = isAtTop ? t - apexTime : 0; const dropVelocity = isAtTop ? -gravity * dropTime : 0; const dropAcceleration = isAtTop ? -gravity : 0; const dropHeight = isAtTop ? apexHeight - 0.5 * gravity * dropTime * dropTime : apexHeight; let tossState = "At launch"; if (t > 0 && t < apexTime) tossState = "Rising"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) tossState = "At the top"; else if (t > apexTime && tossedHeight > 0) tossState = "Falling"; else if (tossedHeight <= 0 && t > 0) tossState = "At launch height"; let dropState = "Held in place"; if (t > apexTime && dropHeight > 0) dropState = "Falling together"; else if (Math.abs(t - apexTime) < 0.05) dropState = "Just released"; else if (dropHeight <= 0 && t > apexTime) dropState = "At launch height"; const ppm = 110; const baseY = 320; const mapY = (h) => baseY - h * ppm; const tossX = 180; const dropX = 460; const ballY_toss = mapY(Math.max(0, tossedHeight)); const ballY_drop = mapY(Math.max(0, dropHeight)); const objects = []; objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 40, y: 40, w: 260, h: 360, title: "Toss lane", state: tossState, id: "lane.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.panel({ x: 320, y: 40, w: 260, h: 360, title: "Drop lane", state: dropState, id: "lane.drop" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.toss", { x: tossX, y: baseY, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.axis("axis.drop", { x: dropX, y: baseY, length: 240, orientation: "y", min: 0, max: 2.2, label: "Height", unit: "m" })); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("ground.toss", tossX, baseY, 60, "0 m")); objects.push(sdk.groundMark("ground.drop", dropX, baseY, 60, "0 m")); if (isAtTop) { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate.drop", dropX, mapY(apexHeight), { open: true, label: "Gate" })); } else { objects.push(...sdk.gate("gate.drop", dropX, mapY(apexHeight), { open: false, label: "Gate" })); } objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.toss", tossX, ballY_toss, 24, { role: "neutral" })); objects.push(sdk.circle("ball.drop", dropX, ballY_drop, 24, { role: "neutral" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.toss", { x: tossX - 16, y: ballY_toss }, { value: tossedVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.toss", { x: tossX + 16, y: ballY_toss }, { value: tossedAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.v.drop", { x: dropX - 16, y: ballY_drop }, { value: dropVelocity, direction: "up" }, { scale: 12, label: "v" })); objects.push(...sdk.vector("vec.a.drop", { x: dropX + 16, y: ballY_drop }, { value: dropAcceleration, direction: "up" }, { scale: 6, label: "a" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(tossX + 35, ballY_toss - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(tossedVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(tossedAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.toss" })); objects.push(...sdk.callout(dropX + 35, ballY_drop - 20, ["v: " + sdk.format(dropVelocity, 2) + " m/s", "a: " + sdk.format(dropAcceleration, 2) + " m/s^2"], { id: "callout.drop" })); return { frame: { width: 640, height: 420, objects, readouts: [{ id: "tossedVelocity", value: tossedVelocity }, { id: "tossedAcceleration", value: tossedAcceleration }, { id: "dropVelocity", value: dropVelocity }, { id: "dropAcceleration", value: dropAcceleration }] }, quantities: { launchSpeed, gravity, apexTime, apexHeight, tossedVelocity, tossedAcceleration, tossedHeight, dropVelocity, dropAcceleration, dropHeight } }; }

manifest.title: Zero velocity isn’t zero acceleration.
manifest.summary: Compare a tossed ball with a ball dropped from the apex to see why acceleration remains non-zero at the top.
manifest.description: Two vertical lanes show a tossed ball and a dropped ball side by side. Arrows show velocity and acceleration at each instant.
assumptions: No air resistance, the same gravity for both balls, up is positive.
manifest.instructions: Change launch speed or gravity, then press Play. At each pause, compare velocity and acceleration.
